title: `stream_with_context`: abandoned generator leaves the app context current on the worker thread; later requests skip `teardown_appcontext`
author: robkooper
body_preview: `stream_with_context` pushes the request's contexts onto whichever thread iterates the response body, and pops them only if the generator completes or is closed on that same thread. When a client disconnects mid-stream, the server abandons the body iterator and GC finalizes it later — often on a different thread.
